body: Six years ago today, Travis Scott @travisscott teamed up with McDonald’s to launch The Travis Scott Meal for $6. The limited-time meal included a Quarter Pounder with cheese, bacon and lettuce, medium fries with barbecue sauce and a Sprite. It also marked the first time since Michael Jordan in 1992 that a celebrity’s name was featured on the McDonald’s menu. The meal was available across the U.S. from Sept. 8 through Oct. 4, 2020.
